stop_rules: Stop admission at the observed token limit; one admitted time-bounded call may exceed it
Stop after any completed attempt with unknown usage and preserve evidence
Stop on isolation violation, schema incompatibility, hard constraint violation or active wall deadline
No automatic repeat of a claimed attempt; failed and interrupted reservations remain consumed
No expansion to 8h, 24h or formal matrix under this proposal
